notes.title: New Update – M.I.K.K.O. Currency Exchange!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Hey there, Barn Finders![/h1][/b]

We hope you're ready for some more barn-raiding madness because we’ve got something fresh for you! First, a quick shout-out to all our fans—you’ve been awesome, and we’re always working to make the game even wackier and more fun. This year alone, we’ve dropped a free map and the Quick Picker tool, but guess what? We’re not done yet!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/12b97b78707c078ab76bb7b693487ec1b7998d64.gif[/img]

[b]What’s New?[/b]
Introducing the [u][b]M.I.K.K.O. Currency Exchange System[/b][/u]—because who doesn’t want to trade junk for resources? The geniuses at M.I.K.K.O. have been hard at work (with minimal coffee breaks) to bring you Exchange $oft! Now, from the comfort of your in-game computer, you can trade cash for essential resources like wood, metal, gas, and scraps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/fd92a18e9a9cbbdccf394caa875537e79445a5c5.gif[/img]

What about trading your soul for money? We tried—but the scientists need a little more time on that one. Maybe next update! 😉

So, jump in, test it out, and as always, let us know what you think. More fun updates are on the way, and we’re just getting started!

[b]Stay weird and keep finding,
The Barn Finders Team[/b]

See you on Halloween, like every year! 🎃👻

notes.title: Barn Finders - The "Quick Picker" Update! 🧤🐔
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello, Barn Finders![/h1]
We've got some exciting news for you. Our latest update introduces a brand-new tool: the Quick Picker! But, of course, this is Barn Finders, so getting your hands on this nifty tool won't be that simple. Remember how you had to face off against the chicken team in basketball to snag those speed boots? Well, the chickens are back, and this time, they’re ready to play... baseball! 🥎🐓
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/ddfe9e9ab7e28af43cae69f1c000719e7dcac50b.gif[/img]

[h2]The Challenge: Baseball Showdown with the Chickens![/h2]
To earn the Quick Picker, you'll need to step up to the plate and defeat our feathery friends in a high-stakes baseball match. Think you've got what it takes to outplay the chickens? You better hope so, because this tool is going to be a game-changer for all you dedicated junk hunters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/d9f206e7ba2f017f7558e385ad62f53264ca0e1b.gif[/img]

[h2]What is the Quick Picker?[/h2]
The Quick Picker is a specialized glove that allows you to pick up more than one resource at a time from the ground. It's going to make your scavenging trips way more efficient. But wait, there's more! The Quick Picker comes with three upgrade levels. Each upgrade increases the glove’s range, allowing you to scoop up resources from a wider area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/44e089a9cb015a447b964e5d2421d3579a11fa3a.gif[/img]
[h2]Why You Need It[/h2]
With the Quick Picker in your arsenal, you’ll be able to gather resources faster and repair those hidden gems in record time. That means more items on your pawnshop shelves and more cash in your pocket! 💰

[h2]Thank You, Barn Finders Community![/h2]
[b]As always, we want to say a huge THANK YOU to all our fans. Your support is the reason this game continues to grow and thrive. We hope you enjoy this latest update, and we can’t wait to see you challenge the chickens once more!
Happy hunting! 🕵️‍♂️
[/b]

notes.title: Bid Wars DLC Production Update
notes.notes:
Hello Barn Finders,

We are more than excited after the launch of the new addition to the Barn Finders family - the Bid Wars DLC. We worked very hard to give you some new and fresh experience while still keeping the good old Barn Finders vibe. We saw your playthroughs, we hear your comments and first of all, we also see your reviews. We know that some of you wanted some good old fashioned Barn Finders experience and the new DLC is not exactly in their taste - we get that and we listen to your feedback very closely. So, here are few things we will be doing in the next few days / weeks:

[olist]
[*] Focusing on DLC bugfixing - we know some of the music is not affected by options, there are some issues with achievements, various small fixes here and there.
[*] Improving the onboarding experience with additional tutorials for interaction with box, crafting etc. 
[*] We are preparing some nice surprises for all the players of the base game, but inspired by the Bid Wars - be ready for some in-game goodies. 
[*] We are preparing the plan for bigger improvements to the DLC, but we need some time to figure it out fully. 
[/olist]

As you can see, we are fully committed to improve your experience and to see the Bid Wars island the way we saw it, both in design and in the production phase. We believe in what we prepared and hopefully you enjoy it the way we do. 

And if you do (and only then)- we would kindly ask you to leave a positive review  - it would greatly help us and motivate us for all the times ahead. 

Once again, thank you for playing the Bid Wars DLC - and see you on an island!

Duality Games Team

notes.title: QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATE - CHICKEN SONAR & CLIENTS SELLING ITEMS
notes.notes:
Howdy Players!

We would like to introduce you to the newest update to the Barn Finders, which except many bug fixes contains also two new mechanics - Chicken Sonar and Clients selling items. 

[h2]Chicken Sonar[/h2]

If you ever had a problem with finding the last one item on the map (who the hell hid them there, right?) - this is a tool for you. Just press and hold button and then release, and the Sonar will inform you if there is any item in your area. As simple as that. You still have to look for it, but it sure makes it a lot easier. And this is what M.I.K.K.O. is aiming for - making things easier! And at a reasonable, but noticeable price! It should work!

[h2]Clients selling items[/h2]

Right outside your pawnshop we put a small little stand. From now on, from time to time, some of the Clients will go there and offer you an item they want to get rid of. You can haggle to get an even better price, before you sell it in your own shop! Just remember - stands open after you finish Aunt’s Marry map - after that it’s all yours to profit from!

But this is not all of the stuff we are working on here, if you look closely on the pawnshop map, you will find a teaser of something else we are currently working on. Stay tuned!

[u]You can also find fixes for some of the bugs:[/u]

-Language in profile menu is now forced to the one that's currently set in Windows
-Cemetery statue rotating parts fixed
-Black hole in Bid Wars 3 fixed
-Added safety zones under each map to prevent falling out of the level
-Crash Zone elevator fixed (falling out of elevator, disappearing buttons)
-Random particle spawn when clients visits the Pawnshop fixed
-Silver Barn auction fixed
-Clients despawning delay removed
-Remapping controls is now working correctly
-Bug that caused disappearing tools in Bid Wars fixed
-Crash Zone switches bug fixed
-Invisible clients should not appear in Pawnshop
-Billy is now able to correctly open the wicket in Knuckles Barn
